identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase II Study of QLS32015 Combination Therapy in the Treatment of Multiple Myeloma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Open-Label Phase II Study to Evaluate QLS32015 Combination Therapy in the Treatment of Multiple Myeloma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of the study is to compare the efficacy of QLS32105 (SC) in combination with Pomalidomide, and QLS32105 (SC) in combination with QL2109 or Daratumumab, and QLS32105 (SC) in combination with QL2109 or Daratumumab and Pomalidomide, and QLS32105(SC) in combination with Bortezomib and Lenalidomide.

armGroups.label: QLS32015(SC) in combination with Pomalidomide
armGroups.description: Participants will receive QLS32015 as SC injections; Pomalidomide will be self-administered as a single dose orally; dexamethasone may be given orally or intravenously as a pretreatment medication and study drug.

armGroups.label: QLS32015(SC) in combination with QL2109 or Daratumumab.
armGroups.description: Participants will receive QLS32015 and QL2109 or Daratumumab as SC injections; dexamethasone may be given orally or intravenously as a pretreatment medication and study drug.

armGroups.label: QLS32015(SC) in combination with QL2109 or Daratumumab and Pomalidomide
armGroups.description: Participants will receive QLS32015 and QL2109 or Daratumumab as SC injections; Pomalidomide will be self-administered as a single dose orally; dexamethasone may be given orally or intravenously as a pretreatment medication and study drug

armGroups.label: QLS32015(SC) in combination with Bortezomib for injection and Lenalidomide
armGroups.description: Participants will receive QLS32015 and Bortezomib as SC injections; Lenalidomide will be self-administered as a single dose orally; dexamethasone may be given orally or intravenously as a pretreatment medication and study drug

primaryOutcomes.description: Overall response (PR or better) is defined as percentage of participants who have a PR or better per International Myeloma Working Group (IMWG) criteria

MRD-negative is defined as proportion of participants who achieve MRD negativity at a threshold of 10\^-5 at any timepoint after the first dose of study drug and before disease progression or start of subsequent antimyeloma therapy

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS is defined as time from the date of randomization to the first documentation of disease progression, or death due to any cause, whichever is reported first
